say:1:1460110001:1.text: With Kruger joining the fight, your group becomes an unstoppable force, quickly taking down all the bandits.
say:1:1460110001:1.source_cn: 有了克鲁格的加入，你们如虎添翼，摧枯拉朽地击败了所有盗匪。

say:2:1460110002:0.text: Kruger quickly tends to the wounded and orders the patrol to bring the captured enemies back before finally greeting you.
say:2:1460110002:0.source_cn: 克鲁格干脆利索地安排好了伤员，又命令巡逻队员们把盗匪押...

say:4:1460110003:0.text: Thank you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, and your friend. Your help was invaluable!
say:4:1460110003:0.male: Thank you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, and your friend. Your help was invaluable!
say:4:1460110003:0.female: Thank you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, and your friend. Your help was invaluable!

choice_prompt:5:1460110003.text: Thank you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, and your friend. Your help was invaluable!
choice_prompt:5:1460110003.source_cn: <style=stress><player_name></style>，还有这位朋友，多亏你们帮忙了！
choice_prompt:5:1460110003.male: Thank you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, and your friend. Your help was invaluable!
choice_prompt:5:1460110003.female: Thank you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, and your friend. Your help was invaluable!

say:6:1460110004:0.text: I was close by—just got held up by another pack of reckless fools!
say:6:1460110004:0.source_cn: 哈哈！因为我就在附近不远，只是被一拨胆大包天的蠢蛋绊住...
say:6:1460110004:0.male: I was close by—just got held up by another pack of reckless fools!
say:6:1460110004:0.female: I was close by—just got held up by another pack of reckless fools!

say:7:1460110006:1.text: Remember when the Grimmaw Clan wiped out those bandits a while back? You pitched in back then too.
say:7:1460110006:1.source_cn: 你也知道，以前黑嚎部落专门派过战士们清剿这些匪徒，你那...
say:7:1460110006:1.male: Remember when the Grimmaw Clan wiped out those bandits a while back? You pitched in back then too.
say:7:1460110006:1.female: Remember when the Grimmaw Clan wiped out those bandits a while back? You pitched in back then too.

say:8:1460110007:1.text: They stayed quiet for a while, but now they're back again.
say:8:1460110007:1.source_cn: 那些家伙老实了一阵子，最近又卷土重来了！
say:8:1460110007:1.male: They stayed quiet for a while, but now they're back again.
say:8:1460110007:1.female: They stayed quiet for a while, but now they're back again.

say:9:1460110008:1.text: And since a lot of our young warriors are still inexperienced, I sent them out to get some real-world practice.
say:9:1460110008:1.source_cn: 而我们这边不少年轻人还太嫩了，我干脆就派他们出来见见世面。
say:9:1460110008:1.male: And since a lot of our young warriors are still inexperienced, I sent them out to get some real-world practice.
say:9:1460110008:1.female: And since a lot of our young warriors are still inexperienced, I sent them out to get some real-world practice.

say:10:1460110009:1.text: Never thought we'd get hit by two groups at once, though.
say:10:1460110009:1.source_cn: ——结果没想到居然一下来了两帮人！
say:10:1460110009:1.male: Never thought we'd get hit by two groups at once, though.
say:10:1460110009:1.female: Never thought we'd get hit by two groups at once, though.

choice_prompt:11:1460110009.text: Never thought we'd get hit by two groups at once, though.
choice_prompt:11:1460110009.source_cn: ——结果没想到居然一下来了两帮人！
choice_prompt:11:1460110009.male: Never thought we'd get hit by two groups at once, though.
choice_prompt:11:1460110009.female: Never thought we'd get hit by two groups at once, though.

say:12:1460110010:1.text: Not really, I held my own just fine. But the young ones probably got a bit banged up.
say:12:1460110010:1.source_cn: 那是，但年轻人们估计就要受点伤了。
say:12:1460110010:1.male: Not really, I held my own just fine. But the young ones probably got a bit banged up.
say:12:1460110010:1.female: Not really, I held my own just fine. But the young ones probably got a bit banged up.

say:13:1460110011:1.text: Bandits were sloppy, but our rookies? Walked right into that trap like headless chickens!
say:13:1460110011:1.source_cn: 真是的，盗匪蠢，他们也蠢！居然能中了那么明显的计！
say:13:1460110011:1.male: Bandits were sloppy, but our rookies? Walked right into that trap like headless chickens!
say:13:1460110011:1.female: Bandits were sloppy, but our rookies? Walked right into that trap like headless chickens!

say:15:1460110012:0.text: It's normal for new fighters to be nervous the first time.
say:15:1460110012:0.source_cn: 年轻人初经战阵，紧张些也是在所难免。

say:16:1460110013:0.text: True enough. Still, I owe you one for saving their skins.
say:16:1460110013:0.source_cn: 总之，还没感谢几位，及时帮手，救了我们这边的小家伙！

choice_prompt:17:1460110013.text: True enough. Still, I owe you one for saving their skins.
choice_prompt:17:1460110013.source_cn: 总之，还没感谢几位，及时帮手，救了我们这边的小家伙！

say:18:1460110014:1.text: We just did what anyone would.
say:18:1460110014:1.source_cn: 举手之劳而已，不必客气。

say:19:1460110015:1.text: Speaking of which, I haven't even asked—who's your capable companion here?
say:19:1460110015:1.source_cn: 对了，说了半天，还没来得及问，这位帮忙的老兄是……

choice_prompt:20:1460110015.text: Speaking of which, I haven't even asked—who's your capable companion here?
choice_prompt:20:1460110015.source_cn: 对了，说了半天，还没来得及问，这位帮忙的老兄是……

say:21:1460110016:1.text: Ah, that explains it. I could tell from the way you handled those bandits.
say:21:1460110016:1.source_cn: 哦？怪不得，刚刚你对付那帮人时我就注意到了！

say:22:1460110017:1.text: You don't see many wield a staff like that, except maybe Soren.
say:22:1460110017:1.source_cn: 除了索恩，很少碰见能把棍子使得这么灵活的家伙！

say:23:1460110018:1.text: If you're here to train in martial arts, how about testing your skills in a proper duel?
say:23:1460110018:1.source_cn: 既然要见识武学，不如直接打一场吧？

say:24:1460110019:1.text: Well... After seeing you fight, Master Kruger, I'd call you a warrior without equal.
say:24:1460110019:1.source_cn: 这……克鲁格先生执斧的英姿我方才也有所目睹，实在是难得...

say:25:1460110020:1.text: Though this may not be the right moment for a duel...
say:25:1460110020:1.source_cn: 只是此时我恐怕不便出手……

say:26:1460110021:1.text: After some explaining, you manage to calm Kruger's enthusiasm for a match.
say:26:1460110021:1.source_cn: 你们七嘴八舌地一番解释，总算让战意十足的克鲁格冷静了下来。

say:27:1460110022:1.text: Then what say you and I spar, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?
say:27:1460110022:1.male: Then what say you and I spar, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?
say:27:1460110022:1.female: Then what say you and I spar, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?

say:28:1460110023:1.text: Let our friend here watch—might learn a trick or two.
say:28:1460110023:1.source_cn: 也方便让这位朋友多观摩嘛！
say:28:1460110023:1.male: Let our friend here watch—might learn a trick or two.
say:28:1460110023:1.female: Let our friend here watch—might learn a trick or two.

choice_prompt:29:1460110023.text: Let our friend here watch—might learn a trick or two.
choice_prompt:29:1460110023.source_cn: 也方便让这位朋友多观摩嘛！
choice_prompt:29:1460110023.male: Let our friend here watch—might learn a trick or two.
choice_prompt:29:1460110023.female: Let our friend here watch—might learn a trick or two.

say:30:1460110024:1.text: I'll watch and learn what I can. Thank you both.
say:30:1460110024:1.source_cn: 那我就在一旁领悟了，多谢两位。

choice:11:0:1.text: Did they give you much trouble?
choice:11:0:1.male: Did they give you much trouble?
choice:11:0:1.female: Did they give you much trouble?

choice:5:0:1.text: You showed up just in time.
choice:5:0:1.male: You showed up just in time.
choice:5:0:1.female: You showed up just in time.

say:32:1460110005:1.text: Ah, yes. I was nearby dealing with another batch of those idiots.
say:32:1460110005:1.source_cn: 被你看出来了！我就在附近不远，对付另外一帮胆大包天的蠢蛋！
say:32:1460110005:1.male: Ah, yes. I was nearby dealing with another batch of those idiots.
say:32:1460110005:1.female: Ah, yes. I was nearby dealing with another batch of those idiots.
